required_outcomes: Reads Leo's email (event 011) as confirmation that the fault persists after the troubleshooting checks, and the landlord's earlier agreement (event 008) as authority to send an engineer to investigate and repair.
Instructs an appliance engineer: assigns a provider, or returns the request to auto mode for provider selection, with the fault description and the tenant's details.
Tells Leo that an engineer will contact him to arrange a time, without inventing a provider name or a date.
Tells the landlord that the checks did not fix the door and an engineer is being sent under her earlier agreement.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the engineer to quote before any work that needs parts, rather than proceeding to an open-ended cost.
Telling the landlord after the engineer is instructed rather than before.
positive_behaviours: Takes the request off hold once the engineer is instructed.
red_flags: Asking the landlord to approve the call-out again.
Asking the tenant to repeat the checks.
prohibited_actions: Inventing a provider, a visit date or a cost.
critical_failures: Leaving the request on hold, or closing it, without arranging an engineer after the tenant has confirmed the fault persists and the landlord has agreed.
